ans.settings.experience: Experience §8Full Experience: the pack's own textures for mobs, items and armour. Vanilla Experience: vanilla-style textures with the pack's animations. Blocks, item icons and GUI: the "Motion & Bits Textures" resource pack.
text.oreville_ans.pbvovd: Entity Biome Variants §8Controls how biome-specific entity variants can spawn.
text.oreville_ans.mihbmn: Morphs §8Replaces the default player model with the Motion & Bits custom model.
text.oreville_ans.wtaqxt: Axolotl Colour §8Changes the colour of the axolotl in the bucket.
text.oreville_ans.wfwwna: Armour Visibility §8Controls armour visibility on the player.
text.oreville_ans.utfxjc: Tool Enchantment Glint §8Controls the look of enchanted tools in hand.
text.oreville_ans.rrtbvo: Enchantment Effect Colour §8Controls the colour of the enchantment glint and outline.
text.oreville_ans.bmendx: Totem of Undying Opacity §8Controls when the totem becomes semi-transparent in first person.
text.oreville_ans.msjzgl: Enable Expressions §8Disable this if you experience issues with skins.
text.oreville_ans.aqwcjr: Costumes §8Enables leather armour costumes (Full Experience Only).
text.oreville_ans.ljwzdo: Item Swap Sounds §8Plays a sound when switching items in the hotbar.
text.oreville_ans.qgoyax: Better Rain Particles §8Switch between custom and Vanilla rain particles.
text.oreville_ans.pboqzn: Legacy Baby Chick Model §8Switch between the Legacy Motion & Bits Chick and new Tiny Takeover Chick model.
